corrected_content.problem:
A curve is defined by the parametric equations
$$
\displaystyle x = t^{2} - 2t, y = t^{5}, - ∞ < t < ∞.
$$

Calculate the equation of the tangent to the curve at the point where $t =-1$.

> A scientific calculator is required to answer this question.
corrected_content.worked_solution:
At $t=-1$ the point is $(3,-1)$. The tangent slope is
$$\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{5t^4}{2t-2}=-\frac54.$$
Hence its equation is $y+1=-\frac54(x-3)$.
